description: One person from the audience, with their counts, tags, notes and mute for your organization, their outreach (owner, stage, last contacted), plus their public profile (bio, company, location, website and linked accounts) where the platform lists it. GitHub authors are looked up today; profile is null until then. With groupId, the person as that keyword group sees them. Email addresses are not returned over MCP: profile.email is always null (the dashboard and the REST API show it where the person published it).

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

id.description: Audience author id (aut_...), from list_people or a mention's authorId

name: get_person
title: Get person
